Subject: POC next steps — scheduling hands-on throughput run and test harness review

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the routing and prefix caching examples. We'd like to move to a hands-on POC rehearsal where we:
- walk through the test harness and fixture setup
- run a short throughput rehearsal (target ~200 requests/sec peak for our pilot)
- validate median P95 latency is under 200ms for 1k token prompts
- exercise a routing failover scenario

Amit and I are available the week of Oct 4 but we'd also be open to a shorter dry-run this Friday afternoon (Oct 1) PT if you have staff available. Can you propose a 90-minute window and an agenda?

Also please send any runbook or sample load plan ahead of time.

Cheers,
Lydia
Senior PM, Nimbus Health

--
Nimbus Health | Secure clinical AI integrations

Subject: Re: POC next steps — scheduling hands-on throughput run and test harness review

Thanks Lydia — great summary.

We can do a focused 90-minute rehearsal. Proposed slots (PT):
- Fri Oct 1, 15:00-16:30
- Tue Oct 5, 09:00-10:30
- Wed Oct 6, 13:00-14:30

Draft agenda (90 min):
1) 10m — Introductions + goals and success criteria (confirm 200 req/s, P95 <200ms)
2) 20m — Test harness walkthrough (load generator, warmup, KV/prefix caching setup)
3) 40m — Throughput rehearsal (2 x 15-min runs at target and at 1.5x load)
4) 10m — Routing failover exercise (simulate zone-level capacity constraint)
5) 10m — Action items and next steps (runbook edits, SLA checklist)

I attached a first-pass runbook and a sample load plan (nimbus-load-plan-2026-10.csv). Rishi will lead the technical portion and Marissa will be on the call for commercial/next-step notes.

If none of those slots work we'll push to the week of Oct 4 — let me know your preferred time and I'll send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Monica
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: POC next steps — scheduling hands-on throughput run and test harness review

Looping in a couple of quick technical notes so the rehearsal is productive:
- Test harness: we usually run the harness from an internal load-generation cluster and can provide a lightweight containerized harness if you prefer local execution. Please confirm whether Nimbus will start load from their VPC or if you want Redwood to initiate.
- Warmup: recommend a 10-minute KV/prompt warmup at 50% of target to populate cache (otherwise you'll see cold-start tail latency).
- Scenarios: please include a 1k-token prompt representative sample and a shorter 128-token control prompt. Attachments above include the sample payloads in the CSV.
- Telemetry: I'll enable per-route token-level tracing and a short retention snapshot so we can inspect outputs for quality regressions.

If Fri Oct 1 works, I'm available 15:00-16:30 PT. If you prefer early next week, Tue Oct 5 09:00 PT also works.

--
Rishi Malhotra
Staff Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
